features.name: Vow of Enmity
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, using Channel Divinity, you give yourself Advantage on attack rolls against one creature for 1 minute.

features.name: Relentless Avenger
features.desc: After you make an Opportunity Attack, you can move up to half your Speed (the target's Opportunity Attacks against you end).

features.name: Soul of Vengeance
features.desc: When the target of your Vow of Enmity makes an attack, you make a melee attack against it as a Reaction.

features.name: Avenging Angel
features.desc: As an action, for 1 minute, you sprout wings (Fly Speed 60 feet) and emit a 30-foot aura of fear.
